people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: “ ‘ “All the inhabitants of Egypt will know that I am Yahweh, because they have been a staff of reed to the house of Israel.
translations.bsb: Then all the people of Egypt will know that I am the LORD. For you were only a staff of reeds to the house of Israel.
translations.kjv: And all the inhabitants of Egypt shall know that I am the LORD, because they have been a staff of reed to the house of Israel.
translations.asv: And all the inhabitants of Egypt shall know that I am Jehovah, because they have been a staff of reed to the house of Israel.
